messages.subject: [IT] Planned DMS maintenance — Saturday 17 January, 07:00–11:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system (NetDocuments) will be unavailable this Saturday 17 January between 07:00 and 11:00 for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please check in any documents you have open before Friday close. Email and calendar are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
